bear_case: There is no budget owner for a standalone translator. Gateway money is spent as hardware (V2X GMR $48.5M reported 2024; ABMS pods; BATS-D terminals) or as incumbent-held data-layer baselines (NGC2, June 2026 with Raft transformation). The documented pain lives mostly in exercises (Bold Quest, CWIX, Project Convergence) where vendors and government cells build the bridge themselves; DIU buys the drone-connectivity problem as network topology (ORIENT), not translation. A translator company converges on integration consultancy.
strongest_single_argument: No RFI, sources sought, SBIR topic or budget line for a standalone message-translation service surfaced in the E02/E04 sweeps or in this session's searches, while every adjacent buy went to a terminal, gateway box or data-layer prime.
what_would_change_my_mind: A PEO C3N, C3BM or DISA solicitation (RFI/CSO/SBIR topic) explicitly for a software-only, terminal-agnostic CoT/VMF/J-series translation service with a named requirement owner and funded line, or an NGC2 baseline change removing transformation from the prime team.
narrower_survivable_version: Unclassified CoT-to-open-coalition-format adapter and conformance kit for drone OEMs/allied units as a feature of an edge-bridge product; not a standalone business.

bear_case: Incumbents already have it: Ultra ADSI (CoT-to-JREAP-C, 21 instances unified), L3Harris BATS-D (handheld Link 16 with ATAK/CoT), Curtiss-Wright TDL gateway, V2X GMR, Systematic SitaWare with USMTF/ADatP-3/MIP/NVG/ASCA and a CoT gateway, Raft/Anduril transformation and federation in the NGC2 baseline, Fuse/Northrop/Collins airborne gateways, BSI VMF gateway, and government-owned ATAK-MIL Link 16 radio drivers. The interfaces (MIDS terminals, JREAP, TAK-MIL adapters, NGC2 data layer) are incumbent- or government-controlled; switching cost is certification, which transfers to no newcomer. An LLM mapping editor is a quarter's feature work for any of them.
strongest_single_argument: The Army assigned 'common models and semantics, registries, transformation mechanisms, interfaces, federation' to the Anduril/Palantir/Raft team on 2026-06-22 - the exact function this gap proposes is now an incumbent-held program baseline.
what_would_change_my_mind: Evidence that ADSI/BATS-D/SitaWare/Raft cannot serve a specific high-volume endpoint class (e.g., Replicator ADA2 swarms) and that DIU or a program office is soliciting a software-only bridge for it from non-incumbents.
narrower_survivable_version: Conformance-test tooling (INSPECT/CWIX-style) that incumbents are certified against rather than a competing gateway - still a niche, likely government-owned in the end.

bear_case: MIL-STD-6016 is Distribution C with AECA/ITAR export restrictions and allied release requires foreign disclosure authorization; MIL-STD-6017 (VMF) is controlled; a credible demo needs a certified terminal, crypto and JITC conformance testing, none of which a prime-less student team can obtain with $250k. The Indonesian co-founder, not assumed a U.S. person, would likely have to be excluded from the core technical data (deemed-export), removing the product/business founder from the product. Procurement through a prime and a program of record is a multi-year path. Only the unclassified CoT/open-format half is demonstrable in 3-6 months for under $100k, and that half is not where the pain or the money is.
strongest_single_argument: The team cannot legally hold the primary specification of the product it would sell (MIL-STD-6016, Distribution C/ITAR) while including its non-U.S.-person co-founder, and cannot demo the Link 16 side without a sponsor it has no path to.
what_would_change_my_mind: A U.S.-person cleared TDL engineer joining as a co-founder, a prime offering terminal access and JITC sponsorship, counsel confirming a workable export-control structure for the non-U.S.-person founder, and a funded requirement for the unclassified half - all four together.
narrower_survivable_version: Open-standards (CoT/MIP/NVG/USMTF/ASCA/STANAG 4586) adapter and conformance kit built entirely from public specifications, sold to allied drone OEMs or as a feature of an edge-bridge product; no Link 16/VMF content.
